### 4.3. Assumptions

Alternative to scopes, it is possible to check satisfiability under the assumption of a set of literals. Thus, the session

```
s.add(Implies(p, q))
s.add(Not(q))
print(s.check(p))
```

also produces the verdict `unsat` as the conjunction of ![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,), ![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,), ![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) is `unsat`. The method `assert_and_track(q, p)` has the same effect of adding `Implies``(p, q)`, and it adds `p` as an implicit assumption. Our running example becomes

```
p, q = Bools('p q')
s = Solver()
s.add(Not(q))
s.assert_and_track(q, p)
print(s.check())
```
